context: A retired engineer mentors a uni student on environmental engineering
purpose: Teach: 大陸/国土/海岸/天然/食料/衛星/輸送/循環

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 環境工学の道に進むなら、まず足元の国土をよく見ることから始めるといい。
lines.en: If you're going down the path of environmental engineering, it's good to start by looking carefully at the land right under your feet.
lines.style: Wise mentor tone, measured and deliberate pacing throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 足元から、ですか。広い視野で考えなきゃいけないと思っていました。
lines.en: From under my feet, you say? I had been thinking I needed to consider it from a broad perspective.
lines.style: Eager student voice, slightly higher pitch with respectful curiosity

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: もちろん大陸全体の動きも大切だが、まずは身近な海岸の様子を観察してみなさい。
lines.en: Of course continent-wide movements matter too, but first try observing the state of the coastline near you.
lines.style: Calm authoritative delivery, slower cadence on technical points

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 実は先週、海岸沿いを歩いていて、漂着ゴミの多さに驚いたんです。
lines.en: Actually, last week I was walking along the coast and I was shocked by the amount of drifting trash.
lines.style: Animated young voice, reflecting genuine academic enthusiasm

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: いい気づきだ。そういう現場の感覚が、衛星画像のデータを読む時にも生きてくるんだよ。
lines.en: That's a good observation. That kind of on-the-ground sense becomes useful even when reading satellite imagery data.
lines.style: Grave seasoned tone, emphasis on key technical terminology

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。授業で衛星データを扱う時、現実感がなくて困っていました。
lines.en: I see. When we handled satellite data in class, I was struggling because it felt detached from reality.
lines.style: Humble appreciative voice, softer and thoughtful in delivery

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 天然資源の乏しい国だからこそ、食料や物の輸送をどう設計するかが鍵になる。
lines.en: Precisely because we're a country poor in natural resources, how we design the transport of food and goods becomes the key.
lines.style: Heartfelt elder voice, warm with paternal encouragement and gravitas

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 天然の制約があるからこそ、循環の発想が必要なんですね。勉強になります。
lines.en: It's precisely because of those natural constraints that the idea of circulation becomes necessary. That's really enlightening.
lines.style: Bright determined young voice, ending with respectful warmth
